class.name: TdJsonClient
class.description: An instance of a TDLib client. Use [code]TdJsonManager.create_client()[/code] or [code]TdJsonClient.create()[/code] to create a new instance. Use [code]send[/code] to send requests and receive responses via the [signal]response_received[/signal] signal.

method.name: close
method.description: Closes the TDLib client instance. After calling this method, the instance will no longer receive responses or updates.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a TDLib client instance and returns it. Instances must be created using this method or [code]TdJsonManager.create_client()[/code].

method.name: get_client_id
method.description: Returns the client ID of the session.

method.name: send
method.description: Sends a request to the TDLib client. May be called from any thread.

method.name: set_bot_token
method.description: Sets the authentication token of a bot and logs in when TDLib reaches [code]authorizationStateWaitPhoneNumber[/code].

method.name: set_tdlib_parameters
method.description: Sets the parameters for TDLib initialization for this client specifically. The request is sent automatically (at most once) when this client reaches [code]authorizationStateWaitTdlibParameters[/code]. If this method is not called, the default parameters set through [method TdJsonManager.set_tdlib_parameters] are used instead. Warning: each client requires its own [code]database_directory[/code] — TDLib holds an exclusive sqlite lock on the directory, so two clients with the same directory cannot run simultaneously. - [code]api_id[/code] - Application identifier for Telegram API access, which can be obtained at [url=https://my.telegram.org]https://my.telegram.org[/url]. - [code]api_hash[/code] - Application identifier hash for Telegram API access, which can be obtained at [url=https://my.telegram.org]https://my.telegram.org[/url]. - [code]application_version[/code] - Application version; must be non-empty. - [code]device_model[/code] - Model of the device the application is being run on; must be non-empty. - [code]database_directory[/code] - Path to the directory for the persistent database; by default uses user data directory ([code]"user://tdlib_data/"[/code]). - [code]use_test_dc[/code] - If true, the Telegram test environment will be used instead of the production environment. - [code]files_directory[/code] - Path to the directory for storing files; by default uses [code]database_directory[/code]. - [code]use_file_database[/code] - If true, information about downloaded and uploaded files will be saved between application restarts. - [code]use_message_database[/code] - If true, the local database will be used for storing chats and messages between application restarts. - [code]use_secret_chats[/code] - If true, support for secret chats will be enabled. - [code]system_language_code[/code] - IETF language tag of the user's operating system language; By default uses locale language of the OS. - [code]system_version[/code] - Version of the user's operating system; By default uses the version of the OS.

signal.name: response_received
signal.description: Emits when a response or update is received for this client.
